MEX.note: World #1 beer exporter and the largest beverage exporter overall. UN Comtrade 2024 confirms 4242 kt beer exports (FOB $6.5bn) plus tequila under HS2208; nearly all to the USA. Production figures kt approximate million-litres basis. Low direct food-security relevance — an agri-processing export, not a staple.

NLD.note: Heineken's home base and Europe's largest beer re-export/brewing hub. UN Comtrade 2024 shows ~419 kt beer to the USA alone (flow M, USA reporter) plus large EU flows. Rotterdam transit inflates gross volumes. 2024.

BEL.note: AB InBev's home market (Leuven HQ); Stella Artois, Leffe, Hoegaarden. FAOSTAT 2024 importer-mirror sums to ~1.9 Mt beer exports led by France (474 kt), Netherlands (396 kt), Spain (260 kt). 2024.

DEU.note: One of the world's largest beer producers and consumers; high domestic absorption keeps net exports modest relative to output. FAOSTAT 2024 mirror shows big flows to Italy (347 kt), China (139 kt), USA (72 kt). kt ~ million litres. 2024.

GBR.note: World's #1 spirits exporter by value — Scotch whisky. UN Comtrade 2024 confirms ~126 kt spirits to the USA (flow M, USA reporter); also a large net beer importer. Both a major exporter (whisky) and importer (beer). 2024.

FRA.note: Cognac and other spirits exporter (excludes wine, a separate commodity). UN Comtrade 2024 confirms ~85 kt spirits to the USA (flow M). Also a large beer importer from Belgium/Netherlands. 2024.

USA.note: World's #1 beverage importer by far (and largest beer market). UN Comtrade 2024 confirms 4905 kt beer imports — Mexico 4047, Netherlands 419, Ireland 127, Canada 89 — plus 792 kt spirits (UK 126, Canada 121, France 85). Huge domestic craft-beer/spirits production too. 2024.

IRL.note: Guinness stout (Diageo) and Irish whiskey exporter. FAOSTAT 2024 mirror shows 378 kt to UK, 166 kt to USA. kt ~ million litres. 2024.

CZE.note: Pilsner-style lager exporter (Pilsner Urquell, Budvar); world-leading per-capita beer consumer. FAOSTAT 2024 mirror: Slovakia 153 kt, Germany 125 kt, Poland 43 kt. 2024.

POL.note: Large EU brewer and vodka producer. FAOSTAT 2024 mirror shows beer flows to Italy (78 kt), Hungary (57 kt), Germany (47 kt). 2024.

CHN.note: World's largest beer-producing nation by volume (Snow/CR Beer, Tsingtao), but almost all consumed domestically, so a modest net trader. FAOSTAT 2024 shows exports to Taiwan (169 kt), Hong Kong (83 kt) and rising spirits (baijiu) trade; also a major premium-import market. 2024.

BRA.note: Among the world's top-3 beer producers (Ambev/AB InBev); output overwhelmingly domestic. FAOSTAT 2024 mirror shows regional exports to Paraguay (188 kt), Bolivia (60 kt), Chile (26 kt). 2024.

ESP.note: Large brewer (Mahou-San Miguel, Damm) and re-exporter; tequila/spirits importer from Mexico. FAOSTAT 2024 mirror: Philippines 69 kt, Portugal 32 kt, plus big imports from Belgium (260 kt) and France. 2024.

ITA.note: Net beer importer (Germany, Belgium, Netherlands) and spirits exporter (Aperol/Campari, grappa, amaro). FAOSTAT 2024 mirror shows exports to UK (166 kt), Germany (78 kt) and large imports. 2024.

DNK.note: Carlsberg's home market and a notable lager exporter. FAOSTAT 2024 mirror shows 160 kt to Germany, 36 kt to Italy, 33 kt to Sweden. kt ~ million litres. 2024.

CAN.note: Whisky (Canadian Club, Crown Royal) exporter and beer trader with the USA. UN Comtrade 2024 (USA reporter, flow M) confirms 89 kt beer + 121 kt spirits from Canada to the USA. 2024.

rankings.note: Exporter ranks led by Mexico (#1 beer, ~4.2 Mt confirmed UN Comtrade 2024 beer exports) and the EU brewing/spirits cluster (Netherlands, Belgium, Germany). Importer ranks led overwhelmingly by the USA — UN Comtrade 2024 confirms 4905 kt beer + 792 kt spirits imports, several times any other market. kt ~ million litres; production-heavy nations (China, Brazil, Germany) consume most output domestically so rank lower on net trade. 2024.

companies.name: AB InBev (Anheuser-Busch InBev)
companies.note: World's largest brewer (~25% of global beer volume); owns Budweiser, Stella Artois, Corona (ex-US), Modelo, Beck's, Leffe, Hoegaarden. Belgium-headquartered with huge Mexican (Grupo Modelo) and Brazilian (Ambev) operations. 2024 output ~595 million hl beer. Drives the Belgium and Mexico export flows in this dataset.
companies.improve: Should map brand-level volumes to the country flows (e.g. how much of Mexico-to-USA is Corona/Modelo vs other) for cleaner attribution.

companies.name: Heineken N.V.
companies.note: World's #2 brewer; Heineken, Amstel, Sol, Tiger, plus a large Mexican arm (Heineken Mexico / former Cuauhtemoc-FEMSA brands). 2024 output ~242 million hl. Anchors the Netherlands-to-USA (419 kt) and broad EU beer flows.
companies.improve: Should separate Dutch-origin Heineken-brand exports from Rotterdam transit re-exports to avoid double-counting gross volumes.

companies.name: Constellation Brands
companies.note: Holds the exclusive US rights to Corona, Modelo and Pacifico, all brewed in Mexico and imported into the USA — the commercial engine behind the ~4.0 Mt Mexico-to-USA beer flow (UN Comtrade 2024). Modelo Especial is the top-selling beer brand in the USA, 2024.
companies.improve: Should disclose the share of the Mexico-USA beer flow it controls vs AB InBev's rest-of-world Corona volumes.

companies.name: Diageo plc
companies.note: World's largest spirits company; Johnnie Walker Scotch, Smirnoff, Tanqueray, Don Julio tequila, plus Guinness (the Ireland-to-UK and Ireland-to-USA stout flows). 2024 net sales ~$20bn. Underpins UK Scotch and Irish stout/whiskey exports.
companies.improve: Should split Scotch (UK-origin) from Guinness (Ireland-origin) and tequila (Mexico-origin) volumes against the respective country flows.

companies.name: Pernod Ricard
companies.note: World's #2 spirits group; Chivas/Ballantine's Scotch, Jameson Irish whiskey, Absolut vodka, Martell cognac. 2024 sales ~EUR12bn. Drives French spirits exports (cognac) plus UK/Irish whiskey flows.
companies.improve: Should attribute Martell cognac (France) vs Jameson (Ireland) vs Absolut (Sweden) tonnages to the matching country-origin flows.

companies.name: Carlsberg Group
companies.note: Major global brewer; Carlsberg, Tuborg, Kronenbourg, plus large Western-European and Asian operations. 2024 output ~120 million hl. Anchors the Denmark-to-Germany (160 kt) and Nordic/EU beer flows in this dataset.
companies.improve: Should map its multi-country brewing footprint (Denmark, France, Poland, China) to origin-country export volumes.

global.note: Global alcoholic beverages excl. wine (beer HS2203 + spirits/liqueurs HS2208), kt on an approximate million-litres basis. Beer dominates by volume (~90%); spirits dominate by value. Production recovered after 2020 COVID dip; ~9-10% of output is internationally traded (most beer is consumed near where it is brewed). Figures synthesised from OECD-FAO, Comtrade aggregates and brewer reports; volume-to-mass conversion approximate. 2024.

forecast.method: OECD-FAO Agricultural Outlook + global brewing/spirits trend; 2030=2024*(1+rate)^6
